nodes.title: FET Phase
nodes.description: Further Education and Training Phase (Grades 10-12)

nodes.title: Mathematics
nodes.description: Mathematics — Grade 12 — CAPS Curriculum

nodes.title: Term 1
nodes.description: SBA: Investigation or project (15%) and Test (15%)

nodes.title: Quadratic patterns (revision)
nodes.description: Revise number patterns leading to those where there is a constant second difference between consecutive terms and the general term is therefore quadratic

nodes.title: Arithmetic and geometric sequences and series
nodes.description: Number patterns, including arithmetic and geometric sequences and series

nodes.title: Sigma notation
nodes.description: Sigma notation

nodes.title: Sum formulae for arithmetic and geometric series
nodes.description: Derivation and application of the formulae for the sum of arithmetic series: Sn = n/2[2a + (n-1)d], Sn = n/2(a + l); geometric series: Sn = a(r^n - 1)/(r - 1) (r != 1); and sum to infinity: S_inf = a/(1 - r) (-1 < r < 1, r != 1)

nodes.title: Functions: Formal Definition, Inverses, Exponential and Logarithmic
Definition of a function
nodes.description: Definition of a function

nodes.title: Inverse of a function
nodes.description: General concept of the inverse of a function and how the domain may need to be restricted (to obtain a one-to-one function) to ensure that the inverse is a function

nodes.title: Graphs of inverse functions
nodes.description: Determine and sketch graphs of the inverses of y = ax + q, y = ax^2, y = b^x (b > 0, b != 1). Focus on: domain and range, intercepts, turning points, minima, maxima, asymptotes, shape and symmetry, average gradient, intervals of increase/decrease

nodes.title: Exponential function and laws (revision)
nodes.description: Revision of the exponential function and the exponential laws and graph of y = b^x where b > 0 and b != 0

nodes.title: Definition of a logarithm
nodes.description: Understand the definition of a logarithm: y = log_b(x) <=> x = b^y where b > 0 and b != 1

nodes.title: Graph of logarithmic function
nodes.description: The graph of y = log_b(x) for both cases 0 < b < 1 and b > 1

nodes.title: Compound angle identities
nodes.description: Compound angle identities: sin(alpha +/- beta), cos(alpha +/- beta), sin(2alpha) = 2sin(alpha)cos(alpha), cos(2alpha) = cos^2(alpha) - sin^2(alpha) = 2cos^2(alpha) - 1 = 1 - 2sin^2(alpha)

nodes.title: Sine, cosine and area rules (revision and proof)
nodes.description: Revise the proof of the sine, cosine and area rules

nodes.title: 2D and 3D problems
nodes.description: Solve problems in two and three dimensions applying the sine, cosine and area rules

nodes.title: Term 2
nodes.description: SBA: Assignment (15%) and June exam/control test (15%)

nodes.title: Similarity conditions (revision)
nodes.description: Revise earlier work on the necessary and sufficient conditions for polygons to be similar

nodes.title: Proportionality and similarity theorems
nodes.description: Prove: a line drawn parallel to one side of a triangle divides the other two sides proportionally (and the Midpoint Theorem as special case); equiangular triangles are similar; triangles with sides in proportion are similar; the Pythagorean Theorem by similar triangles

nodes.title: Revision of line equations and inclination
nodes.description: Revise: equation of a line through two given points; equation of a line through one point parallel or perpendicular to a given line; inclination (theta) of a line where m = tan(theta) (0 <= theta <= 180 degrees)

nodes.title: Equation of a circle
nodes.description: Apply the equation (x - a)^2 + (y - b)^2 = r^2 that defines a circle with radius r and centre (a, b)

nodes.title: Tangent to a circle
nodes.description: Determine the equation of a tangent to a given circle

nodes.title: Factor and remainder theorems
nodes.description: Factorise third-degree polynomials. Apply the remainder and factor theorems to polynomials of degree at most 3 (no proofs required)

nodes.title: Limit concept
nodes.description: An intuitive understanding of the limit concept, in the context of approximating the rate of change or gradient of a function at a point

nodes.title: Definition of derivative using limits
nodes.description: Use limits to define the derivative of a function f at any x: f'(x) = lim(h->0) [f(x+h) - f(x)]/h. Generalise to find the derivative function f'(x). Understand intuitively that f'(a) is the gradient of the tangent at point with x-coordinate a

nodes.title: Derivative from first principles
nodes.description: Using the definition (first principle), determine f'(x) for: f(x) = ax^2 + bx + c, f(x) = ax^3, f(x) = a/x, and f(x) = c

nodes.title: Power rule and differentiation rules
nodes.description: Use the formula d/dx(ax^n) = anx^(n-1) for any real n, together with rules for sum/difference and constant multiples

nodes.title: Equations of tangents
nodes.description: Determine equations of tangents to graphs of functions

nodes.title: Second derivative and concavity
nodes.description: Introduce the second derivative f''(x) = d/dx(f'(x)) and how it determines the concavity of a function

nodes.title: Cubic function sketching
nodes.description: Sketch graphs of cubic polynomial functions using differentiation to determine coordinates of stationary points and points of inflection. Determine x-intercepts using the factor theorem and other techniques

nodes.title: Optimisation and rate of change
nodes.description: Solve practical problems concerning optimisation and rate of change, including calculus of motion

nodes.title: Term 3
nodes.description: SBA: Test (15%) and Trial examination (25%)

nodes.title: Growth and decay formulae (revision)
nodes.description: Revise and use simple and compound growth and decay formulae: A = P(1 +/- in) and A = P(1 +/- i)^n to solve problems (including straight line depreciation and depreciation on a reducing balance)

nodes.title: Present value and future value annuities
nodes.description: Solve problems involving present value and future value annuities

nodes.title: Logarithms for time period
nodes.description: Make use of logarithms to calculate the value of n (time period) in the equations A = P(1 + i)^n or A = P(1 - i)^n

nodes.title: Investment and loan analysis
nodes.description: Critically analyse investment and loan options and make informed decisions as to best option(s) (including pyramid schemes)

nodes.title: Revision of statistical representations
nodes.description: Revise: histograms, frequency polygons, ogives (cumulative frequency curves), variance and standard deviation of ungrouped data, symmetric and skewed data, identification of outliers

nodes.title: Regression and correlation
nodes.description: Use statistical summaries, scatterplots, regression (in particular the least squares regression line) and correlation to analyse and make meaningful comments on bivariate data, including interpolation, extrapolation and discussions on skewness

nodes.title: Probability rules (revision)
nodes.description: Revise: addition rule P(A or B) = P(A) + P(B) - P(A and B); mutually exclusive events; complementary rule; independent events and product rule; Venn diagrams for three events A, B, C; tree diagrams for consecutive/simultaneous events

nodes.title: Fundamental counting principle
nodes.description: Apply the fundamental counting principle to solve probability problems

nodes.title: Advanced probability problems
nodes.description: Probability problems using Venn diagrams, tree diagrams, two-way contingency tables and the Fundamental Counting Principle to solve problems (where events are not necessarily independent)

nodes.title: Term 4
nodes.description: Final examination. Paper 1 150 marks 3 hours (Algebraic expressions/equations/inequalities 25, Number patterns 25, Functions and graphs 35, Finance/growth/decay 15, Differential Calculus 35, Counting principle and probability 15). Paper 2 150 marks 3 hours (Statistics 20, Analytical Geometry 40, Euclidean Geometry 40, Trigonometry 50)
